verses: ٱلَّذِىٓ أَطْعَمَهُم مِّن جُوعٍ وَءَامَنَهُم مِّنْ خَوْفٍۭ

leads.title: Covenant at Shechem; 'choose this day whom you will serve'; deaths of Joshua and Eleazar ↔ Quraysh, small kindnesses and al-Kawthar
leads.summary: 1 correspondence read side by side: 1 shared wording.

evidence.text: Read side by side in both originals (alignments/hb-quran/08-hb-quran.yaml).

Shared motifs, rarest first: Quraysh's security pact (ilaf) and caravan journeys of winter and summer; they should worship the Lord of this House who fed and secured them (weight 6.7). Pair score 6.7.

Only in Covenant at Shechem; 'choose this day whom you will serve'; deaths of Joshua and Eleazar: God set darkness between Israel and the pursuing Egyptians; A priest is buried on the hill belonging to his son; Leader warns: you cannot serve YHWH, for he is a holy and jealous God; Joshua buried at Timnath-serah/heres north of Mount Gaash; The people are told to choose this day whom they will serve; The words of a covenant are written in a book of the law of God; Repeated mutual disavowal: 'I do not worship what you worship, nor do you worship what I worship'; 'to you your religion and to me mine'; The people are made witnesses against themselves to their choice; God was pleased with the believers when they pledged allegiance to the prophet under the tree (Bay'at al-Ridwan); A great stone set up as a witness because it has heard all God's words; God turned Balaam's curse into a blessing; Isaac given, and Jacob in addition as an extra gift (nāfila) [divergence between the texts]; and 10 more.

Only in Quraysh, small kindnesses and al-Kawthar: The one who hates the prophet is the one cut off (al-abtar, without posterity); Woe to those who pray but are heedless of their prayer, make a show, and withhold small kindnesses (al-ma'un); God has given the prophet al-Kawthar (abundance; in tradition a river or pool in paradise); 'pray and sacrifice'; God says he is sated with sacrifices and hates festivals and new moons offered by those whose hands are full of blood; The deniers do not honor the orphan, push him away, and do not urge the feeding of the poor.

passages.text: וָאֶתֵּ֨ן לָכֶ֜ם אֶ֣רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֧ר לֹֽא יָגַ֣עְתָּ בָּ֗הּ וְעָרִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא בְנִיתֶ֔ם וַתֵּשְׁב֖וּ בָּהֶ֑ם כְּרָמִ֤ים וְזֵיתִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא נְטַעְתֶּ֔ם אַתֶּ֖ם אֹכְלִֽים
וְעַתָּ֞ה יְר֧אוּ אֶת יְהוָ֛ה וְעִבְד֥וּ אֹת֖וֹ בְּתָמִ֣ים וּבֶֽאֱמֶ֑ת וְהָסִ֣ירוּ אֶת אֱלֹהִ֗ים אֲשֶׁר֩ עָבְד֨וּ אֲבוֹתֵיכֶ֜ם בְּעֵ֤בֶר הַנָּהָר֙ וּבְמִצְרַ֔יִם וְעִבְד֖וּ אֶת יְהוָֽה
ٱلَّذِىٓ أَطْعَمَهُم مِّن جُوعٍ وَءَامَنَهُم مِّنْ خَوْفٍۭ
